title: Which firm pairs the card states
idea: Laying the card's blocks over the 4,656 pair probabilities shows the pairs it states and the confident pairs it leaves unsaid.
from: v1 view · v1 S-02 case-krw-race, the heat-map view
credit: After Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), section V.E (Figure 5A) and slides 54–56. Firms as adapted in postrank 1.1.0 (pr_case_krw). Cards computed with KRW's code (KRW replication companion) under KRW's archived pair probabilities.
caption: All 97 firms; exact released contact-gap pair probabilities and supplied central 90% intervals. The data describe KRW’s historical experiment, not any firm’s current conduct.
